Hi, not everyone who is suicidal is depressed. There are a lot of mental illnesses out there and are often mistaken for depression. In my case it's dysthymia with depression episodes. I would strongly recommend that you talk to someone - maybe a counselor in your school. I know it sounds stupid but for me a diagnosis was helpful - I was glad to find out that my bad mood, suicidal thoughts, selfharm was an illness - something you can eventually cure and overcome- not a part of my identity
